title: EEOC file listing
blurb: Every link on EEOC's appellate decisions page, as of the last crawl. An index of files, not of decisions.

asOf.sql: SELECT CAST(max(first_seen) AS VARCHAR) FROM t
asOf.label: Newest link first seen: {value}.

covers: One row per link listed on https://www.eeoc.gov/federal-sector/appellate-decisions. The first full crawl was 2026-11-01 and matched the site's own total that day; a daily job adds new links.
caveats: The posted date is the date in the file's folder name on eeoc.gov. It is when EEOC posted the file, not when the decision was issued.
The number in a file name does not reliably identify a decision. Many numbers appear in more than one file, and some names have no usable number.
Page and position are where the link was first seen. EEOC's listing order shifts, so use the URL as the identifier.
A couple of rows link to the bare site root, https://www.eeoc.gov.
